title: Japanese Ochazuke
description: A Japanese-inspired dish, popular in Thailand, where rice is drenched in a savory green tea broth.

ingredients.name: Gooey butter
ingredients.notes: Optional: may be substituted with a similar thickener

instructions: 1. Cook Japanese rice according to package instructions.
2. In a separate pot, brew Ochazuke tea according to package instructions.
3. In a large bowl, combine cooked rice and brewed tea.
4. If using gooey butter, stir it in to thicken the mixture.
5. Drizzle yellowish sesame oil over the rice and tea mixture.
